QuestInfo.name: Silas the Blacksmith
QuestInfo.0: Silas Irons, the Blacksmith of Perion, seems to have a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1:
Silas needs more Iron to work. He said any kind of Iron is fine, so eliminate Iron Hogs and Iron Boars, and collect #t4000178#s and #t4000039#s for him. 
Most Iron Hogs and Iron Boars live in #m102030200#, so you should start there.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Silas the materials he requested.

0.0: Hey hey, #h0#! Feel like giving me a hand? I've got a mountain of orders, and a molehill of materials! Ha!

yes.0: Anything that has Iron in it is fine. I can refine whatever you bring me to get the good stuff out. Try hunting some Iron Boars and Iron Hogs at #m102030200#. About 75 Armor Fragments from Iron Boars and 75 Metal Hooves from Iron Hogs should be plenty.

no.0: You too busy to help now? That's no problem. Maybe I'll start making gear out of dirt! Got plenty of that around here!

1.0: Did you bring all those bits I wanted?

yes.0: Great! I can't wait to get back to work.

item.0: That's not enough to make a butter knife! I said I need 75 Iron Boars' Armor Fragments and 75 Iron Hogs' Metal Hooves.
